描述_EN: meomi design is a duo of vicky wong and michael murphy, illustrators, animators and designers who have produced books and television series for children. muk muk was the ‘official sidekick’ of the 2010 vancouver winter olympic games. the three official mascots were quatchi the sasquatch, miga the seabear and sumi a chimera. he is a marmot, an endangered species native to the area where the event was held. the production and release of the vancouver 2010 merchandise was phased, and initially muk muk only existed online, but he was soon produced as a plush toy. all three were designed from legends of canadian aborginal culture but other influences include the olympic and paralympic movements, modern animation styles and the culture and wildlife of british columbia and canada.
描述_ZN: meomi design是由Vicky wong和Michael murphy组成的二人组，他们是插画师、动画师和设计师，曾为儿童制作书籍和电视系列。 Muk Muk是2010年温哥华冬奥会的 "官方伙伴"。 三个官方吉祥物是大脚野人Quatchi、海熊Miga和奇美拉Sumi。 它是一只旱獭，一种原产于赛事举办地的濒危物种。 温哥华2010年商品的生产和发布是分阶段的，最初Muk Muk只存在于网上，但他很快就被生产成了毛绒玩具。 这三个都是根据加拿大土著文化的传说设计的，但其他影响包括奥运会和残奥会运动、现代动画风格以及英属哥伦比亚和加拿大的文化和野生动物。
